audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart disagreed with content and packet: full had Akshan at levels 1-2 and Skill at 3, 4-5, first item and 2+ items, while content win[] and packet levelChart both give Sylas 1-2, Akshan 3-5, Sylas 6, Skill first item, Sylas late.
audit.why: Akshan's Avengerang is weak level 1 and Heroic Swing (E) only arrives at 3 — pre-E he cannot kite Sylas; with E he jukes Abduct; at 6 Comeuppance is a weak duel ult vs Hijack burst.
audit.corrected: Full sides aligned to the content/packet chart, whys rewritten to the new verdicts.

audit.why: Spikes coherent: Akshan 3-5 with E kiting, Sylas 6 (weak enemy duel ult), even first item, Sylas two items — matches content layer.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldowns field had no digit; Heroic Swing's 18s rank-1 cooldown and knock-off-on-collision never stated.
audit.why: Kit: E 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s, R 100/85/70s, W camouflage. Riot's E text says he 'gets knocked off when colliding with champions' — walking into the swing path ends it, and his swing needs terrain, so open lane kills the tool.
audit.corrected: Numbers and the collision knock-off written into breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[1].d.

audit.why: Both were verbatim tradeGood/tradeBad under unrelated titles.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to match their titles with kit-grounded content.

edits.before: Q-poke the wave contacts — the chain detonation chips while you wait for the real kit at 3.
edits.after: His level-1 Avengerang is weak and the hook isn't up yet — your Chain Lash out-pokes him freely.

edits.before: W joins: the heal-strike makes even trades dishonest — yours refunds, his doesn't.
edits.after: W joins and he still has no swing: he cannot kite your Petricite autos, so short trades are yours.

edits.before: Full kit: E2-chain into Q-W with passive whirls is the lane's best level-3 all-in nobody respects yet.
edits.after: Heroic Swing arrives: he swings off terrain to juke your Abduct and burst-autos you with passive stacks.

edits.before: Chain-trade on cooldown: shield in, stun, whirl the passive autos, heal out. The brawl is the plan.
edits.after: His E mobility and Q-zoning keep kiting your melee kit — trade only in the long window after a swing.

edits.before: Hijack online — your R is whatever his best button is. The lane's power budget just became a shared account.
edits.after: Hijack online — Comeuppance is a weak duel ult, so a clean Abduct into stolen R bursts his squishy frame.

edits.before: Late Sylas shops the enemy team: steal the fight-flipper, flank with it, and heal through the refund policy.
edits.after: Two items of brawl sustain out-duel his glass build — drag him to melee, where the swing can't save him.

edits.before: - Akshan Heroic Swing: matchup-defining — His swing engage/escape — fight only while it is down. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Abscond (shield-dash) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Heroic Swing is 18s at rank 1 — it is his engage AND escape, so a spent swing opens the longest fight window in the lane. It also needs terrain: hug open lane and it has nothing to hook. - Comeuppance runs 100/85/70s and duels poorly. - Your Hijack cycles at 80/55/30s.

edits.before: E-shield in, E2-chain, Q-W with whirls between, heal out — the full brawl string he answered with one rotation and regret.
edits.after: He gets knocked off the swing when he collides with a champion — stand in the arc or chain him mid-swing and the escape ends at your feet.

edits.before: Chaining into a loaded CC with W down — Sylas without the heal is a mage who chose melee for the aesthetic.
edits.after: Your E shield must absorb his passive-stacked burst autos on entry — dashing in after the trade starts means eating them raw.

notes: Chart: content win[] and packet levelChart agree exactly (Sylas 1-2, Akshan 3-5, Sylas 6, Skill first item, Sylas 2+ items); full sides were moved to match — no win[] edits needed. Rows 0-1 kept their 6/10 rating (now correctly Sylas-side). Row 5 stays Skill on both layers per both sources. report[8].t still says 'Add anti-heal early into his sustain' — Akshan's kit text shows a shield (Dirty Fighting), not healing, so the anti-heal advice is dubious, but it was not lint-flagged and I could not verify whether his passive shield-on-proc counts; recorded as unverified rather than edited. No misgendering: Akshan is he/him.
